title: Hana — Réussir sa vie, pas seulement sa carrière
style: Modern stylized 3D animation, warm color palette, soft cinematic lighting, expressive character, high quality render

character.name: Hana
character.description: Hana, a 31-year-old North African woman, impeccable low ponytail, chic black blazer and gold earrings, magnetic public smile, deep thoughtful eyes

scenes.vo: Sur les réseaux, la vie de Hana fait rêver.
scenes.image_prompt: Hana taking a radiant selfie in a beautiful rooftop bar over Paris at sunset, glamorous, her phone showing streams of likes and fire emojis
scenes.motion_prompt: She takes the selfie with a perfect smile, hearts and likes float up the screen, city glitters

scenes.vo: Le poste à responsabilités. Le bel appartement. Les voyages. Toutes les cases sont cochées.
scenes.image_prompt: Fast montage mood: Hana leading a meeting, Hana in a designer apartment, Hana at an airport with elegant luggage, saturated instagram-perfect colors
scenes.motion_prompt: Quick elegant transitions between the three success scenes, everything shines slightly too much

scenes.vo: Mais le dimanche soir, quand elle pose son téléphone… il ne reste que le silence.
scenes.image_prompt: Sunday night, Hana on her designer sofa in a dim silent apartment, phone face down on the table, city lights through the window, mask dropped, real melancholic face
scenes.motion_prompt: She puts the phone down, the artificial glow dies, her public smile slowly fades into her real tired face

scenes.vo: Trois mille abonnés. Et personne à appeler. Des « collègues », des « contacts », des « followers ». Mais des liens vrais ? Aucun.
scenes.image_prompt: Hana scrolling her contact list in the dark, hundreds of names sliding past, her thumb hovering without stopping on anyone, blue lonely light
scenes.motion_prompt: Names scroll endlessly under her thumb, she stops, locks the phone, stares at the ceiling

scenes.vo: Un dimanche comme ça, elle tombe sur une phrase : « Des soirées pour faire de vraies rencontres. » Vraies. Ce mot-là.
scenes.image_prompt: Close on Hana's phone showing the Nour Meet promise on screen, her eyes catching on the word, warm golden light beginning to replace the blue
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow zoom on her eyes reading, a blink, the light on her face warms from blue to gold

scenes.vo: Un dîner en petit comité. Sans filtre, sans vitrine, sans personnage. Juste elle. Et ça a tout changé.
scenes.image_prompt: A warm restaurant dinner where Hana laughs naturally without posing for once, no phone on the table, genuine faces around her, candlelight, she looks ten years lighter
scenes.motion_prompt: Real unposed laughter, she covers her mouth laughing, the table joins in, candles dance

scenes.vo: Aujourd'hui, ses dimanches soirs ont des voix, des rires, des projets. Ça ne se poste pas. Ça se vit.
scenes.image_prompt: Sunday evening, Hana's apartment full of life: friends cooking together in her kitchen, laughing, her phone forgotten on a shelf, golden warm light everywhere
scenes.motion_prompt: Friends cook and laugh around her, she watches the scene with quiet happiness, warm steam rises

scenes.vo: La vraie réussite, c'est les liens. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
